rationale: The email uses the primary #00704A green for the hero and CTA sections to create immediate brand recognition and strong visual impact. Two strategically placed CTA buttons—one in the hero and one in a secondary green section—maximize app download conversions. The gold accent divider with #CBA258 creates visual rhythm between sections without overwhelming the design. The compact benefits list keeps the message scannable for the 18-35 target audience, while the minimal footer with the tagline reinforces Starbucks' community-driven brand voice.
